ABOUT THE ROLE:

SpaceXAI is seeking a Controls Technician to support the implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of control systems for our data centers and infrastructure. • Help monitor and report on key metrics like PUE and infrastructure performance via dashboards.
• Coordinate with teams to respond to utility grid events and adjust systems as needed.

• Associate's Degree in a technical field (e.g., Controls Technology, Mechatronics, Automation, or equivalent experience).
• 3+ years of hands-on experience as a technician working with industrial control systems.
• Experience with Ignition SCADA or similar programming.
• Familiarity with Siemens TIA Portal or equivalent PLC programming.

• Proficiency in troubleshooting industrial equipment using IEC 61131-3 languages (e.g., ladder logic).
• Experience with hardware from Siemens, SEL, Rockwell, or similar.

• Strong problem-solving skills with a methodical approach.
• Excellent documentation and communication abilities.
• Ability to manage tasks independently in a team environment.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work extended periods standing, in tight quarters, and exposed to noise.

Senior Finance Data Governance Consultant (Contract)

*This is a 12 month temporary assignment

Sony Interactive Entertainment is seeking an experienced, hands-on Finance Data Governance consultant to help establish and operationalize SIE’s Finance Data Governance capability. The role will partner across Finance and Technology to define governance standards, document critical Finance data and lineage, establish data quality controls, govern master data and hierarchies, and support priority Finance data products.

The ideal candidate should have 8+ years of experience in data governance, Finance transformation, or Finance data management, with strong knowledge of financial processes and systems. Experience with SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake, data catalog/governance platforms such as Atlan or Collibra, and enterprise reporting tools is preferred. The candidate should be comfortable working independently in a greenfield environment and translating complex Finance and technical requirements into practical, sustainable governance processes.

Responsibilities:

Establish the Finance Data Governance Foundation

• Assess the current maturity of Finance data governance, documentation, ownership, controls, and data management practices.
• Design and implement a practical Finance Data Governance operating model, including roles, decision rights, governance forums, workflows, escalation paths, and operating cadences.
• Create governance standards, procedures, templates, decision logs, issue-management routines, and approval processes that Finance and Technology teams can use in practice.

Build the Finance Data Inventory and Business Glossary

• Identify and inventory priority Finance data domains, systems, tables, reports, interfaces, data products, calculations, mappings, and critical data elements.
• Document business definitions, ownership, stewardship, approved usage, security classification, refresh frequency, and downstream dependencies.
• Resolve conflicting definitions across Accounting, FP&A, management reporting, statutory reporting, and regional Finance teams.
• Prepare metadata for publication in an enterprise data catalog and establish workflows for maintaining, reviewing, approving, and retiring governance documentation.

Document Data Lineage and Finance Transformation Logic

• Map data from source systems through integration, transformation, consolidation, reporting, and analytical consumption.
• Document business rules, transformation logic, mappings, allocations, eliminations, adjustments, currency translation, and reconciliation points.
• Identify manual transformations, uncontrolled spreadsheets, duplicated logic, missing ownership, and lineage gaps, and support impact assessments for upstream changes.
• Partner with technical teams to distinguish business lineage from physical and technical lineage.

Establish Data Quality and Financial Data Controls

• Define practical Finance data quality standards, rules, thresholds, monitoring requirements, and acceptance criteria.
• Build a data quality rule inventory and support issue identification, triage, root-cause analysis, ownership, remediation, escalation, and closure.
• Develop data quality scorecards and maintain traceable and auditable evidence for approvals, exceptions, reconciliations, and remediation activities.

Govern Finance Master Data and Hierarchies

• Document and govern Finance master data, reference data, mappings, and hierarchies, including accounts, cost centers, profit centers, entities, products, regions, currencies, scenarios, and reporting periods.
• Define ownership, approval, versioning, effective dating, and change-control requirements.
• Partner with master-data and technology teams on future hierarchy-management and Master Data Management initiatives, including business requirements, process design, testing, and downstream-impact assessment.

Support Priority Finance Data Products

• Apply governance standards to priority Finance data products and procedures.
• Support documentation and validation of SAP financial and consolidation data, including ACDOCA and ACDOCU where applicable.
• Help document data flows and reconciliation requirements across SAP, consolidation and reporting platforms, Snowflake, Domo, planning tools, and downstream reports.·
• Support the development of governed enterprise context and semantic layers for reporting, analytics, and AI-enabled Finance use cases.

Drive Adoption and Manage Delivery

• Facilitate workshops, prepare executive-ready updates, develop training materials, and coach data owners and stewards on their responsibilities.
• Translate complex Finance and technical concepts into clear documentation and decisions.
• Establish a repeatable onboarding approach for new data domains and data products.
• Promote governance as an enabler of faster, more reliable reporting and analytics rather than as an administrative exercise.
• Develop and maintain a prioritized governance backlog with defined owners, deliverables, dependencies, and completion criteria.
• Work independently, identify missing requirements, and move ambiguous work toward resolution.

Required Qualifications:

• Eight or more years of experience in data governance, Finance data management, Finance transformation, financial systems, data quality, metadata management, or related consulting roles.
• Demonstrated experience establishing or materially improving a data governance and data strategy capability in a complex enterprise.
• Strong understanding of Finance processes, including general ledger, management reporting, financial consolidation, planning, forecasting, close, and reconciliation.
• Experience documenting financial data definitions, business rules, mappings, hierarchies, lineage, controls, and data quality requirements.
• Experience partnering with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, data engineering, business intelligence, security, and enterprise technology teams.
• Ability to distinguish business ownership and governance responsibilities from technical platform and engineering responsibilities.
• Strong facilitation skills and the ability to drive decisions across stakeholders with different priorities.
• Demonstrated ability to create detailed, usable deliverables with limited existing documentation or structure.
• Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce both detailed working documentation and executive-level summaries.
• Experience working in a consulting, transformation, or contractor environment where measurable deliverables and knowledge transfer are required.
• Ability to operate independently in an ambiguous, fast-moving, greenfield environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance and related financial data structures, consolidation, or group reporting (e.g., ACDOCA, ACDOCU).
• Experience with cloud data platforms, enterprise analytics/reporting tools, and data governance/catalog platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI, Domo, Atlan, Collibra, Purview, or similar).
• Strong understanding of data quality and architecture, including SQL, data profiling/reconciliation, dimensional modeling, semantic layers, hierarchies, and modern data architectures.
• Experience working with Finance data in SOX-controlled or audit-sensitive environments, including data supporting automation and AI; consulting, Finance transformation, or enterprise data advisory experience preferred.

As a Principal Data Engineer on Teamfight Tactics CoreTech, you will own the technical direction and long-term health of TFT’s data ecosystem, from telemetry and schemas to govern data products, metrics, pipelines, and production operations.

You will partner closely with Game Engineering, Design, Product, Insights, and Data Science from feature conception through launch and live operations. You will translate player and product needs into scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient data solutions, while establishing the standards and operating practices that allow TFT teams to move quickly without compromising data trust.

This is a Principal-level individual contributor role. You will lead ambiguous, multi-team initiatives; make architecture and prioritization tradeoffs; mentor engineers and data practitioners; and influence data-engineering standards across TFT and Riot. You will remain hands-on where it creates leverage, while raising the effectiveness of the broader team through technical direction, coaching, and durable systems.

Responsibilities:

• Own the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for TFT’s data ecosystem in partnership with TFT and Riot Data Engineering leadership.

Who We Are

2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K's portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today's most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.

Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers are the professional publishing stewards of 2K's portfolio, which currently includes several AAA, sports and entertainment brands — including global powerhouse NBA® 2K, renowned BioShock®, Borderlands®, Mafia, Sid Meier's Civilization® and XCOM® brands; popular WWE® 2K and WWE® SuperCard franchises, TopSpin 2K25, and the critically and commercially acclaimed PGA TOUR® 2K.

At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don't meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!

What We Need

As Senior Manager, International GTM for EMEA and LATAM, you will be a senior strategic leader responsible for shaping and executing the regional go-to-market approach for NBA 2K across the region. This is not an executional support role. We're looking for someone who can build the regional strategy from the brief up, own paid media planning end to end, and show up as a credible, trusted face of the brand for our most important external partners.

You'll work in close partnership with the global marketing team to ensure our campaigns are globally coherent and locally effective. This role requires someone who thinks strategically, operates with urgency, and builds strong relationships across internal teams and external partners alike.

What You'll Own

• Regional GTM Strategy: Lead the development and delivery of EMEA go-to-market plans that translate the global campaign into regionally effective, culturally resonant marketing. Serve as the regional strategic voice, advocating for local nuance without losing the thread of the global brief.
• Paid Media Planning and Execution: Own the paid media strategy and execution for EMEA from annual planning and channel mix through in-market optimization and performance evaluation. Act as the senior lead in agency relationships, holding partners accountable to both the brief and the business targets.
• External Partner Management: Serve as the primary external-facing representative for NBA 2K across EMEA, building and managing relationships with key agency, media, and marketing partners. Set the tone for how the brand shows up in every external conversation and ensure executional excellence across all partner-led activity.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Community and Creator, Paid Influencer, and Product Marketing leads to ensure EMEA is fully integrated across all GTM pillars. Champion a more connected way of working across the international team and help establish the workflows that make it stick.
• Team Leadership: Manage, mentor, and develop direct reports across the EMEA team. Own their growth and create a high-functioning team environment that works effectively across time zones.
• Performance and Evaluation: Drive performance conversations throughout the campaign lifecycle, identifying what's working, flagging where adjustments are needed, and leading the regional evaluation process with Commercial, Insights, and Marketing Strategy stakeholders.

What Will Make You a Great Fit

• Experienced: proven experience in marketing with meaningful experience in international or regional strategy, ideally within gaming, entertainment, or consumer brands. You've built plans, not just executed them.
• Agency Management: You've managed agency relationships at a senior level and know how to get the best out of them. You can write a tight brief, hold partners accountable to it, and course-correct when the work isn't landing without burning the relationship.
• Paid Media Fluency: You've owned media plans at a senior level. You understand channel strategy, can hold agencies accountable, and know how to optimize in-market.
• Strategic: Comfortable operating at the campaign level while staying close enough to the details to catch what's slipping. You bring a point of view to every room you're in.
• External-Facing: A natural relationship-builder with experience representing a brand to outside partners, agencies, and stakeholders. You know how to build trust quickly and maintain it.
• Collaborative: Skilled at navigating complex, matrixed organizations and building strong cross-functional alignment across departments and time zones.
• Communicative: Strong written and verbal communicator who can translate complex regional context into clear direction for global stakeholders, and vice versa.
• Passionate about Sports and Gaming: A genuine affinity for basketball culture and an understanding of the NBA 2K franchise and its community is a meaningful advantage.

The Role:
As a RFIC Design Engineer, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to conceive and design innovative product solutions. You will work closely with an internal inter-disciplinary team, and third party suppliers to drive key aspects of product definition, execution and optimization. You must be responsive, flexible and able to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment.

As a member of the RFIC team, you will be responsible for the architectural definition, design, simulation, layout, and extracted simulation for transmit and receive front-ends from data converters to LNAs and PAs. Strong focus will be on creating power and cost optimized solutions for a given system performance.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate with communications systems, digital design, and chip implementation teams to specify and implement transceivers and RFIC front-end models which will delight future Kuiper customers.
• Lead implementation of area/power-efficient RFIC chips with multiple transceiver chains with integrated PLLs from concept to production.
• Work closely with packaging/HW/EE/FW teams to ensure seamless system integration providing best value for Kuiper customers.
• Collaborate with the digital design team to define analog/digital boundary requirements for circuit calibration, clock generation, and timing.
• Explore architectures for mm-wave and RF circuits like VCOs, mixers, phase shifters, LNAs, PAs, LO distribution, frequency multipliers and dividers, and envelope/power detectors, and make detailed presentations on power/area/performance trade-offs.
• Design and simulate on-chip inductors, baluns, and power combiners in tools such as EMX or HFSS.
• Perform circuit layout, RLC extraction, and run extracted simulation across various corners to make sure designs are robust and can be taken to volume production.
• Specify bench and production test plans for your designs.
